# FastAPI APIs
## Organizations&#x2F;JWT Forward

|:---|:---|:---|:---|

## Common&#x2F;OAuth
|Intent|API|Path|Source File|
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
|Google OAuth 연동 조회 API (연동 후) sns_id + account_type 조합으로 기존 |`queryGoogleOauthCommonOauthGoogleGet`|`GET /common/oauth/google`|`./tsup.config.ts`|
|Google OAuth 연동 등록 API (연동 전) 프론트에서 Google 로그인 후 받은 authoriz|`registerGoogleOauthCommonOauthGooglePost`|`POST /common/oauth/google`|`./tsup.config.ts`|
|Google OAuth 토큰 직접 등록 API 이미 발급받은 access_token과 refresh_toke|`registerGoogleOauthByTokenCommonOauthGoogleTokenPost`|`POST /common/oauth/google/token`|`./tsup.config.ts`|
|현재 사용자의 OAuth 계정 조회 API 캐시에서 가장 최근 로그인한 OAuth 계정 정보를 조회합니다. |`getCurrentGoogleOauthCommonOauthGoogleCurrentGet`|`GET /common/oauth/google/current`|`./tsup.config.ts`|
## Organizations
|Intent|API|Path|Source File|
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
|Organizations 목록 조회|`getOrgIndexOrganizationsGet`|`GET /organizations`|`./tsup.config.ts`|
|Cognito User에 Organization id 추가하여 토큰 발급|`createOrganizationTokenOrganizationsTokenPost`|`POST /organizations/token`|`./tsup.config.ts`|
|Organization에 속한 Workspace list|`getOrganizationWorkspacesOrganizationsWorkspacesGet`|`GET /organizations/workspaces`|`./tsup.config.ts`|
|Organization에 속한 User 전체 조회|`getOrganizationUsersOrganizationsUsersGet`|`GET /organizations/users`|`./tsup.config.ts`|
|Organization의 공용자산 전체 조회|`getOrganizationAccountsOrganizationsAccountsGet`|`GET /organizations/accounts`|`./tsup.config.ts`|
|Organization의 공용조산을 id로 조회|`getOrganizationAccountByIdOrganizationsAccountsAccountIdGet`|`GET /organizations/accounts/{account_id}`|`./tsup.config.ts`|
|조직 전체의 특정 account_type에 해당하는 media_account들에 대한 일괄 수집 요청 req|`bulkCollectMediaAccountsByAccountTypeOrganizationsMediaAccountsBulkCollectPost`|`POST /organizations/media_accounts/bulk_collect`|`./tsup.config.ts`|

## Workspaces &#x2F; Media Accounts
|Intent|API|Path|Source File|
|:---|:---|:---|:---|
|workspace 하위 모든 media account 조회|`getMediaAccountsWorkspacesWorkspaceIdMediaAccountsGet`|`GET /workspaces/{workspace_id}/media-accounts`|`./tsup.config.ts`|
|특정 media_account 조회|`getMediaAccountByIdWorkspacesWorkspaceIdMediaAccountsMediaAccountIdGet`|`GET /workspaces/{workspace_id}/media-accounts/{media_account_id}`|`./tsup.config.ts`|
|media 삭제|`deleteMediaAccountByIdWorkspacesWorkspaceIdMediaAccountsMediaAccountIdDelete`|`DELETE /workspaces/{workspace_id}/media-accounts/{media_account_id}`|`./tsup.config.ts`|
|자산 수정 내역 조회 api|`getMediaAccountUpdateHistoryByIdWorkspacesWorkspaceIdMediaAccountsMediaAccountIdUpdateHistoryGet`|`GET /workspaces/{workspace_id}/media-accounts/{media_account_id}/update/history`|`./tsup.config.ts`|
|DM에 해당 미디어 어카운트 수집 요청|`collectRequestToDmWorkspacesWorkspaceIdMediaAccountsMediaAccountIdCollectPost`|`POST /workspaces/{workspace_id}/media-accounts/{media_account_id}/collect`|`./tsup.config.ts`|
|자산 수집 요청 내역 조회 API(IET-6386)|`getCollectHistoriesWorkspacesWorkspaceIdMediaAccountsMediaAccountIdCollectHistoriesGet`|`GET /workspaces/{workspace_id}/media-accounts/{media_account_id}/collect/histories`|`./tsup.config.ts`|
|media_account id를 기준으로 dw_account_id 조회|`getDwAccountIdByMediaAccountWorkspacesWorkspaceIdMediaAccountsMediaAccountIdDwAccountIdGet`|`GET /workspaces/{workspace_id}/media-accounts/{media_account_id}/dw_account_id`|`./tsup.config.ts`|
|토큰 리프레시가 필요한 미디어 정보 조회 API(Google, Facebook, G-sheet에 한함)|`getNeedToRefreshAccountsWorkspacesWorkspaceIdMediaAccountsNeedToRefreshGet`|`GET /workspaces/{workspace_id}/media-accounts/need-to-refresh`|`./tsup.config.ts`|
|Media account 세부 내역 조회(사용중인 Report Template 목록)|`getMediaAccountIncludedWorkspacesWorkspaceIdMediaAccountsIncludedGet`|`GET /workspaces/{workspace_id}/media-accounts/included`|`./tsup.config.ts`|
|media account status on/off 수정|`putStatusInMediaAccountWorkspacesWorkspaceIdMediaAccountsMediaAccountIdStatusPut`|`PUT /workspaces/{workspace_id}/media-accounts/{media_account_id}/status`|`./tsup.config.ts`|
|각 센터의 상태 및 수집 날짜 업데이트 API(시스템 유저 전용)|`updateMediaAccountStatusByCenterTypeWorkspacesWorkspaceIdMediaAccountsMediaAccountIdStatusPost`|`POST /workspaces/{workspace_id}/media-accounts/{media_account_id}/status`|`./tsup.config.ts`|
|Media account 컬럼 삭제 시, 사용 중인 리포트 확인(GA, Airbridge)|`getMediaAccountColumnIncludedWorkspacesWorkspaceIdMediaAccountsColumnIncludedGet`|`GET /workspaces/{workspace_id}/media-accounts/column-included`|`./tsup.config.ts`|
|media account 센터별 상태값 조회|`getMediaAccountCenterStatusWorkspacesWorkspaceIdMediaAccountsMediaAccountIdCenterStatusGet`|`GET /workspaces/{workspace_id}/media-accounts/{media_account_id}/center-status`|`./tsup.config.ts`|
|미디어 어카운트의 수집 상태 캘린더 조회|`getCollectHistorySummaryWorkspacesWorkspaceIdMediaAccountsMediaAccountIdCollectHistorySummaryGet`|`GET /workspaces/{workspace_id}/media-accounts/{media_account_id}/collect/history-summary`|`./tsup.config.ts`|
|수집 요청 취소 API 1. 취소할 존재 여부 및 날짜 요청 확인 2. Resource가 아니면 DM에 비동|`cancelCollectionRequestWorkspacesWorkspaceIdMediaAccountsMediaAccountIdCancelPost`|`POST /workspaces/{workspace_id}/media-accounts/{media_account_id}/cancel`|`./tsup.config.ts`|
|재수집 요청 취소 API|`cancelUserRequestedCollectionWorkspacesWorkspaceIdMediaAccountsMediaAccountIdCancelUserRequestedPost`|`POST /workspaces/{workspace_id}/media-accounts/{media_account_id}/cancel-user-requested`|`./tsup.config.ts`|
